items.question: What are Nyara Sabally's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Nyara Sabally averaged 12.3 points, 5.3 rebounds, and 1.7 assists in 24 games for the Toronto Tempo.

items.question: Are Nyara and Satou Sabally sisters?
items.answer: Yes. Nyara Sabally is the younger sister of WNBA forward Satou Sabally. The two were teammates at Oregon in 2018-19 and 2019-20.

items.question: What team does Nyara Sabally play for?
items.answer: Nyara Sabally plays for the Toronto Tempo and wears No. 8. Toronto took her from the New York Liberty in the 2026 WNBA Expansion Draft.

items.question: How old is Nyara Sabally?
items.answer: Nyara Sabally was born February 26, 2000, and is from Berlin, Germany.

items.question: When was Nyara Sabally drafted?
items.answer: The New York Liberty selected Nyara Sabally fifth overall in the 2022 WNBA Draft.

items.question: Where did Nyara Sabally play college basketball?
items.answer: Nyara Sabally played at Oregon. She tied the school's single-game NCAA Tournament scoring record with 31 points against Belmont.

items.question: Has Nyara Sabally played in the Olympics?
items.answer: Yes. Nyara Sabally played for Germany at the 2024 Paris Olympics. She made 12 free throws against France, tying the record for most made free throws in an Olympic game since 1988.

items.question: Did Nyara Sabally win a championship with the Liberty?
items.answer: Yes. Nyara Sabally had 13 points and seven rebounds in Game 5 of the 2024 WNBA Finals, when the Liberty won their first championship.
